name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted cloud file storage similar to Google Drive, with AES-256 encrypted files on disk, MongoDB metadata, sharing and media thumbnails.

alerts.message: Anyone who can reach the URL can create an account. After signing up, set BLOCK_CREATE_ACCOUNT to true and redeploy to close registration.
Files are encrypted with the generated KEY variable. Back it up and never change it, or every stored file becomes unreadable.
MongoDB 8.0 needs a CPU with AVX support on x86_64 servers (ARMv8.2-A on arm64).
